card.name: Last zero in blood count thresholds
card.fires_on: The final digit 0 of a blood-count cutoff such as 100,000 or 1500 right before /mm 3, and the word 'or' in 'free or total' IgE.

modes.label: Final zero in cell counts
modes.description: The last 0 of a platelet or neutrophil count threshold, just before a unit like /mm 3.
modes.example: Platelet count less than 30,00<<0>>/mm 3 Withhold NINL

modes.label: Or in free or total
modes.description: The word 'or' joining free and total serum IgE in omalizumab dosing text.
modes.example: is not dependent on serum IgE (free<< or>> total) level or body weight
